Open a shell in the tenant environment worktree

Usage:
  erun open [TENANT] [ENVIRONMENT] [flags]

Flags:
      --dry-run                Resolve and trace mutating actions without executing them.
      --environment string     Open a specific environment
  -h, --help                   help for open
      --intellij               Open the remote environment in IntelliJ IDEA instead of a shell
      --no-alias-prompt        Skip prompting to add a local shell alias with --no-shell
      --no-shell               Print shell commands to switch kubectl context, namespace, and worktree locally
      --no-snapshot            Alias for --snapshot=false
      --runtime-image string   Override the runtime image repository before opening
      --snapshot               Build and deploy a local snapshot when opening the local environment (default true)
      --tenant string          Open a specific tenant
      --version string         Override the runtime chart and image version before opening
      --vscode                 Open the remote environment in VS Code instead of a shell

Global Flags:
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase trace verbosity. -v logs command flow and side effects.
